title: Size mode names its calipers Width and Height, not Gap
goal: When you click an element in Size mode of the Measure tool, the two calipers it adds are listed in the spec list and the layer list as Gap whenever the last caliper you drew was a spacing one. A width should be called Width and a height Height whatever you measured before.
notes: Found by the scripted playtest walk (Scripts/playtest/redline-walk.json, 2026-09-02): EditorState.addElementSize starts both calipers from measureStyle, so content.role is whatever the popover last held (.spacing here) and MeasureSpecList.derivedName then says Gap. Force role = .size for the two calipers it builds (keep mode horizontal/vertical so Width/Height derive), with a test in MeasureSpecListTests or MeasureTests.
acceptance: After a spacing measurement, a Size click adds rows named Width and Height in the layers list and the copied spec list
The role word in the spec list reads (size) for both of those rows
Distance and Gap keep the role the style popover shows

log.note: Reproduced from the recorded redline-walk log: the Size click landed as "Gap = 121 px [spacing]" and "Gap = 30 px [spacing]". Running a gap-then-size walk in the probe to see it live, and added a MeasureSpecListTests case pinning the contract Size mode will use (styles.content(for: .size) names Width/Height, keeps size ink, leaves the popover role alone).

Reproduced live in the probe (gap click, then Size click, copy spec list): both Size calipers came out as "Gap: N px (spacing)". Fix in EditorState.addElementSize: both calipers start from measureStyles.content(for: .size) when roles are on (Size ink, like Gap mode takes Spacing ink), from measureStyle otherwise, and role is pinned to .size either way. Also made measureStyleForActiveMode preview Size mode in Size ink so the hover matches what lands. Running Scripts/test.sh and the walk again.

LayersPanel names rows via the same MeasureSpecList.displayName, so the layer list follows.

Adversarial pass: the only judgment call was whether Size should also take Size ink when roles are on. Went with yes, mirroring Gap mode taking Spacing ink, and made the hover preview use that ink too so what you see is what lands. With roles off, the single shared ink stays and only the role is pinned.
